posts.title: The NYT Games app is terrible, actually
posts.description: I'm a daily user of the NYT Games app on iOS, and have been for years. The first thing I do every single morning is Spelling Bee and then the crossword. I also do Connections, Wordle and occasionally Sudoku if I'm particularly bored. There's one thing about it that really bugs me though, and that's the amount of recognition it's received from Apple.
